titre: La consommation électrique des centres de données américains s'envole
sous_titre: Consommation d'électricité des centres de données aux États-Unis, en TWh

2014 à 2016.texte: Data center energy use remained fairly stable between 2014–2016 at about 60 TWh

2018.texte: by 2018 data centers consumed about 76 TWh, representing 1.9% of total U.S. electricity consumption

2023.texte: reaching 176 TWh by 2023, representing 4.4% of total U.S. electricity consumption

2028 (bas).texte: with the low and high end of roughly 325 and 580 TWh in 2028

2028 (haut).texte: with the low and high end of roughly 325 and 580 TWh in 2028
